<!--
  The simple intro (model intro@1): an optional badge, a large heading, a description and up to two links as the
  actions (the first primary, the second secondary, each drawn only when its label and its address are both
  set). Text only. Axes: place (middle: the copy in the middle of the section, bottom: low in a tall section,
  min-h-96).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type IntroSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    badge?: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    actionLabel?: string;
    actionHref?: string;
    secondaryActionLabel?: string;
    secondaryActionHref?: string;
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    place?: "middle" | "bottom";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    badge = "",
    title,
    description = "",
    actionLabel = "",
    actionHref = "",
    secondaryActionLabel = "",
    secondaryActionHref = "",
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "center",
    place = "middle",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: IntroSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const itemsAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
    : "items-start"
  );
  const selfAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
    : ""
  );
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="intro-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Stack
      gap="0"
      align={column}
      justify={(((place as string) === "bottom") ? "end" : "center")}
      class={(((place as string) === "bottom") ? "min-h-96" : "")}
    >
      <Stack gap="6" align={column} class="w-full">
        {#if badge}
          <Badge variant="secondary">
            {badge}
          </Badge>
        {/if}
        <Title as={level} size="5xl" weight="bold" class={cn("max-w-4xl tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="lg" class={cn("max-w-2xl text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
        {#if ((actionLabel && actionHref) || (secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref))}
          <Group gap="4" align="center" justify={column} class="flex-wrap">
            {#if (actionLabel && actionHref)}
              <LinkButton variant="default" size="lg" href={urlOf(actionHref)}>
                {actionLabel}
              </LinkButton>
            {/if}
            {#if (secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref)}
              <LinkButton variant="secondary" size="lg" href={urlOf(secondaryActionHref)}>
                {secondaryActionLabel}
              </LinkButton>
            {/if}
          </Group>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </Container>
</Block>
